title: "Results"
subtitle: "Every metric saved by the pipeline, step by step"
---

```{python}
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import _lib as L

num = L.fmt
opis, dobor = L.metrics("opis_danych"), L.metrics("dobor_materialow")
czasy, m41, m42, m43 = (L.metrics(n) for n in ["tagowanie_czasy", "ocena_41", "ekstrakcja_42", "frekwencje_43"])
m5, m6, m7 = (L.metrics(n) for n in ["llm_5", "pule_6", "pseudoslowa_7"])
kand = L.csv("kandydaci.csv")
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 110, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "font.size": 9})
INK, ACCENT, MUTED = "#2c3e50", "#18bc9c", "#b4bcc2"

def kv(d, headers=("Item", "Value"), sort=False):
    items = sorted(d.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if sort else d.items()
    L.table(items, list(headers), "lr")
```

Run **`{python} L.RUN_NAME`** of configuration **`{python} L.NAME`**. All numbers are read from
the files in `{python} f"wyniki/{L.NAME}/{L.RUN_NAME}/metryki/"` when the site is rendered; the raw files are shown on the
[Reproduce](reproduce.qmd#raw-metrics-files) page. Polish key names from the files are kept where they identify a
column or a setting.

## 1 · Corpus {#corpus}

### Selection of materials

```{python}
labels = {"etap": "Catalogue entries of the school stage", "bez_przedmiotu_etapu": "… without a subject of that stage (dropped)",
          "typ_wykluczony": "… of an excluded type, addressed to teachers (dropped)",
          "tylko_jezyk_obcy": "… foreign-language subjects only (dropped)", "wybrane": "Selected (target + contrast)",
          "cel": "of which target subject"}
L.table([(labels.get(k, k), v) for k, v in dobor.items()], ["Stage of selection (whole ZPE catalogue)", "Materials"])
```

From the selected materials this run sampled `{python} num(opis.get("materialy_cel"))` target materials and
`{python} num(opis.get("materialy_kontrast"))` contrast materials (six contrast materials per target one), with the
seed from the configuration.

### Size

```{python}
rows = [
    ("Materials, target (biology)", opis.get("materialy_cel")),
    ("… assigned to biology only", opis.get("materialy_cel_tylko_ten_przedmiot")),

    ("Parsing errors", opis.get("liczba_bledow")),
]
L.table(rows, ["Measure", "Value"])
```

Word counts cover the segment types used for statistics
(`{python} ", ".join(opis.get("segmenty_w_statystykach", []))`); image descriptions (`alt`) are kept in the corpus but

## 2 · Tagging and lemmatisation {#tagging}

### Benchmark on `{python} num(m41.get("n"))` forms

Each tool lemmatised the same forms in their sentence context. *Exact* means the whole base form equals the
reference; *components* means each word of the answer shares a lemma with the matching word of the reference, even
if the phrase as a whole was not rebuilt in the nominative.

```{python}
tools = m41.get("narzedzia", {})
strata = sorted({k.split("__")[1] for d in tools.values() for k in d if k.startswith("lemat_dokladny__")})
st_lab = {"rzadki termin": "rare terms", "wielowyrazowe": "multiword", "pozostale": "other"}
n_zpe = next((d.get("n_ref_redakcja_ZPE") for d in tools.values()), None)
rows = [(f"`{t}`", d.get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie"), d.get("lemat_skladniki_wszystkie"),
         d.get("lemat_dokladny_ref_redakcja_ZPE"), d.get("lemat_dokladny_ref_tymczasowa"),
         *[d.get(f"lemat_dokladny__{s}") for s in strata]) for t, d in tools.items()]
rows.sort(key=lambda r: -(r[1] or 0))
L.table(rows, ["Tool", "Exact, all", "Components, all", f"Exact, ZPE reference (n = {n_zpe})", "Exact, provisional reference",
               *[f"Exact, {st_lab.get(s, s)}" for s in strata]])
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Share of forms whose base form equals the reference."
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bar chart of exact-match lemmatisation accuracy by tool."
prod = __import__("yaml").safe_load((L.ROOT / "config" / f"{L.NAME}.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["narzedzia"]["tager_produkcyjny"]
order = sorted(tools, key=lambda t: tools[t].get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie") or 0)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 2.6))
vals = [tools[t].get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie") or 0 for t in order]
bars = ax.barh(order, vals, color=[ACCENT if t == prod else INK for t in order])
ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=3)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_xlabel("exact match, all forms (production tagger highlighted)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

::: {.callout-warning title="What the reference is"}
`{python} "The sheet has been checked by a human and the scores use those answers." if m41.get("referencja_ludzka_z_arkusza") else "The sheet has not been checked by a human yet."`
Until it is, the reference is the base form written by ZPE editors where one exists, and otherwise a provisional
answer from the adjudicating language model. The editors' forms were not written for this study (some keep the
plural, for example), and a reference written by a language model may favour the LLM lemmatisers. The sheet itself is on the
[Annotation worksheets](sheets.qmd) page.
:::

```{python}
L.md("Composition of the sample:")
src = {"redakcja ZPE": "ZPE editors", "tymczasowa": "provisional (LLM)"}
L.table([(st_lab.get(r["warstwa"], r["warstwa"]), src.get(r["zrodlo_referencji"], r["zrodlo_referencji"]), r["n"]) for r in m41.get("sklad", [])],
        ["Stratum", "Reference from", "Forms"], "llr")
if m41.get("uwaga"):
    L.md(f"Note saved with the metrics (PL): *{m41['uwaga']}*")
```

```{python}
         ("… multiword", m42.get("n_mwu")), ("TermoPL ran", m42.get("termopl")),
         ("Silver standard: glossary entries", m42.get("srebrny", {}).get("slowniczek")),

kv(m42.get("etykiety_regulowe", {}), ("Pre-label", "Candidates"), sort=True)
```

### Precision and recall at K against the silver standards

Each method ranks all candidates; the table shows what share of its top K is in the silver standard (P@K) and what
share of the silver items present among the candidates it has reached by K (R@K).

```{python}
prec = m42.get("precyzja_wzgledem_srebrnego", {})
mlab = {"ll_kontrast": "log-likelihood vs contrast", "log_ratio_kontrast": "log ratio vs contrast",
        "simple_maths_kwjp": "Simple Maths vs KWJP100", "tfidf_biol": "TF-IDF across subjects",
        "pmi_mwu": "PMI (multiword)", "logdice_mwu": "logDice (multiword)", "cvalue_termopl": "TermoPL C-value"}
sets = {"vs_union": "Union of both", "vs_slowniczek": "Glossary entries", "vs_pojecie_ref": "Editors' base forms"}
parts = ["::: {.panel-tabset}"]
for key, title in sets.items():
    rows = []
    for m, d in prec.items():
        if "status" in d:
            rows.append((mlab.get(m, m), d["status"], *[""] * 5))
        else:
            v = d.get(key, {})
            rows.append((mlab.get(m, m), *[v.get(f"{x}@{k}") for x in "pr" for k in (100, 300, 1000)]))
    parts += [f"#### {title}", L.table_md(rows, ["Method", "P@100", "P@300", "P@1000", "R@100", "R@300", "R@1000"])]
L.md("\n\n".join(parts + [":::"]))
```

The silver standard only contains what ZPE editors chose to put in glossaries, so low precision does not mean the
top candidates are wrong. It supports comparison between methods only.

## 5 · LLM classification {#llm}

```{python}
ag = m5.get("zgodnosc_miedzy_modelami", {})
rows = [("Candidates labelled", m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych")), ("Adjudicated (models disagreed or low confidence)", m5.get("n_rozstrzyganych_opus")),
        ("Agreement between the two models", ag.get("prosta"))]
rows += [(f"Cohen's κ, {k.replace('_vs_', ' vs ')}", v) for k, v in (ag.get("kappa") or {}).items()]
rows += [("Materials used for direct LLM term extraction", m5.get("n_materialow_ekstrakcja")), ("Prompt version", m5.get("wersja_promptu")),
         ("API spend so far for this configuration, all runs", f"${m5.get('koszt_usd_dotychczas', 0):.4f}"),
         ("Wall-clock time of the step", f"{num(m5.get('czas_s'))} s")]
L.table(rows, ["Measure", "Value"])
```

::: {.callout-warning title="Agreement is not accuracy"}
There are no human labels yet. The worksheet for double annotation is on the
[Annotation worksheets](sheets.qmd) page; precision, recall and F1 against people can be reported only after it is
filled in.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Final labels

```{python}
cat = {"T3": "T3 · subject term", "T2": "T2 · school / academic vocabulary", "T1": "T1 · everyday vocabulary", "SZUM": "SZUM · noise"}
L.table([(cat.get(k, k), v) for k, v in m5.get("rozklad_final", {}).items()], ["Final label of LLM-labelled candidates", "Candidates"])
```

#### Model against model

```{python}
mcols = [c for c in kand.columns if c.endswith("_kategoria") and not c.startswith("opus")]
if len(mcols) >= 2:
    a, b = mcols[:2]
    sub = kand.dropna(subset=[a, b])
    ct = pd.crosstab(sub[a], sub[b]).reset_index().rename(columns={a: f"{a.replace('_kategoria', '')} ↓ / {b.replace('_kategoria', '')} →"})
    L.df_table(ct)
    L.md(f"Computed from `kandydaci.csv`, {num(len(sub))} candidates labelled by both models.")
```

#### Adjudicated cases

```{python}
ocols = [c for c in kand.columns if c.startswith("opus") and c.endswith("_kategoria")]
if ocols and len(mcols) >= 2:
    adj = kand.dropna(subset=ocols[:1])
    rows = [(m.replace("_kategoria", ""), int((adj[m] == adj[ocols[0]]).sum()), len(adj)) for m in mcols[:2]]
    L.table(rows, ["Model", "Cases where the adjudicator chose the same label", "Adjudicated cases"])
```

:::

## 6 · Pools {#pools}

```{python}
L.table([("Rows in `kandydaci.csv`", m6.get("n_kandydaci_csv")), ("Subject pool (T3)", m6.get("n_pula_przedmiotowa")),
         ("General pool (T1 + T2)", m6.get("n_pula_ogolna")), ("Concept groups", m6.get("n_pojec")),
         ("Rows in the gold-set worksheet", m6.get("n_zloty"))], ["Measure", "Value"])
src = kand["kategoria_final"].notna().map({True: "LLM", False: "rule only"})
ct = pd.crosstab(kand["kategoria"], src)
ct["all"] = ct.sum(axis=1)
ct = ct.sort_values("all", ascending=False).reset_index().rename(columns={"kategoria": "Label used for the pools"})
L.md("Where the label of each candidate comes from:")
L.df_table(ct)
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Candidates by label and by source of the label."
#| fig-alt: "Stacked horizontal bar chart of candidate counts per label, split into LLM-labelled and rule-only."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 2.3))
lab = ct.iloc[::-1]
left = None
for colname, color in [("LLM", INK), ("rule only", MUTED)]:
    if colname in lab:
        ax.barh(lab.iloc[:, 0], lab[colname], left=left, color=color, label=colname)
        left = lab[colname] if left is None else left + lab[colname]
ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.set_xlabel("candidates")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

`do_llm` are candidates the rules left undecided and that were not among those sent to the models; they are in
neither pool.

## 7 · Pseudowords {#pseudowords}

```{python}
acc, rej = L.csv("pseudoslowa.csv"), L.csv("pseudoslowa_odrzucone.csv")
L.table([("Templates (real words)", m7.get("n_szablonow")), ("Pseudoword rows kept", m7.get("n_zaakceptowanych")),
         ("… distinct strings", acc["pseudoslowo"].nunique()), ("Rows rejected by the filters", m7.get("n_odrzuconych"))], ["Measure", "Value"])
rows = []
for m in sorted(set(acc["metoda"]) | set(rej["metoda"])):
    a, r = acc[acc["metoda"] == m], rej[rej["metoda"] == m]
    rows.append((f"`{m}`", len(a) + len(r), len(a), a["pseudoslowo"].nunique(), len(r)))
L.table(rows, ["Generator", "Generated", "Kept", "Kept, distinct strings", "Rejected"])
```
